record.label: Bell-basis parity for controlled spin swaps
record.statement: Swapping the two spin qubits for one orbital changes the sign of the antisymmetric Bell state. After a Clifford change of basis, the full block of swaps acts by a sign on states with an odd number of such pairs, conditioned on the original swap control.
record.boundary: The paper counts 58 Toffolis, or 232 T gates, for one parity computation. Reusing the parity and erasing it by X-basis measurements gives the Table S3 count of 464 T gates for two computations, compared with 928 T gates for four swap blocks in the baseline.
